review_evidence: README describes MusicNotation as a pure functional music-notation system providing notes, pitches, measures, scores, constructors and Unicode rendering.
A complete scan of the seven primary Lean files found 71 declaration-style implementation/data-model items and zero theorem, lemma, axiom or proposition-example declarations.
The source models and renders notation as application data; it does not formalize and prove a mathematical theory or independent semantics of musical notation.

source_action.content_invariant: The seven primary files contain music-notation data structures, constructors, transformations and Unicode formatting but no proposition/proof declarations or independently proved notation semantics; retirement removes no mathematical theorem/proof corpus.
